verdict.rationale: SigNoz is an observability platform with AI features (MCP server, agent skills, LLM observability), so a data-training privacy posture is a fair axis. The evidence pack has no policy, setting, or contractual commitment about using customer data to train AI models. Self-hosting to keep 'full control of your data plane' is a deployment option, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
